meta.name: facebook-groups-scrape-posts
meta.description: Scrapes posts from a Facebook group given a group URL, sort order, and desired count — returns structured post metadata including post_id, permalink, author, timestamp, body text, images/videos, reaction counts, reaction type breakdown, comment count, and share count. Use when: user wants to scrape/extract Facebook group posts, collect FB group content, harvest group data, get posts from a Facebook group, monitor Facebook group activity, bulk export group posts, facebook groups scraping, facebook-groups-scrape-posts, fetch FB group feed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从 Facebook 群组抓取帖子数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要批量获取 Facebook 群组帖子内容与互动数据。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to bulk extract posts and engagement data from Facebook groups.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你提供的 Facebook 小组链接、排序方式和数量，自动抓取小组帖子并返回结构化数据，包括帖子 ID、链接、作者、时间、正文、图片/视频、反应数、评论数和分享数。
howto.when: 当你要求抓取或导出 Facebook 小组帖子，例如说“帮我抓取这个小组的帖子”或“导出小组内容”时触发。

say.text: 导出“程序员幽默”小组按最热排序的 50 条帖子。
say.note: Claude 会按最热排序抓取 50 条帖子。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can scrape posts from a Facebook group given the group URL, sort order, and desired count, returning structured metadata including post ID, permalink, author, timestamp, body text, images/videos, reaction counts, comment count, and share count.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to scrape or export Facebook group posts, e.g., "scrape posts from this group" or "export group content".

say_en.text: Scrape the latest 20 posts from this group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/programmerhumor
say_en.note: Claude will fetch 20 posts in chronological order and return details.

say_en.text: Export 50 top posts from the "Programmer Humor" group.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch 50 posts sorted by top posts.
